Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations.

Thomas Bennett is a 62-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. For the past two months, he has had episodes of a rapid, fluttering heartbeat several times weekly, lasting a few minutes. Episodes are sometimes accompanied by mild lightheadedness. He denies fainting, chest discomfort, or shortness of breath.

Please evaluate Mr. Bennett for these intermittent palpitations and provide recommendations for further care.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Timothy Moore
Pinecrest Primary Care
